'''2021 Retro Event''' (PDS2) was the Players Committee Premiere–Death Star II constructed event on GEMP, May 2021. [[Bastian Winkelhaus]] finished 1st in the published Top 8.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-retro-event-top-8-pds2/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Site:''' GEMP
* '''Dates:''' May 2021
